description: Create an AI avatar video with HeyGen. The avatar speaks a script using a selected voice. Returns a video_id to poll for completion.

avatar_id.description: Avatar ID (use heygen_list_avatars to find available avatars)

avatar_style.description: Avatar style: normal, circle, closeUp (default: normal)

script.description: The text the avatar will speak

test.description: Set true to generate a watermarked test video (does not use quota)

voice_id.description: Voice ID (use heygen_list_voices to find available voices)

name: heygen_create_avatar_video
